title: Return of the Mount Hua Sect
altTitles: Return of the Flowery Mountain Sect
description: Chung Myung, the 13th disciple of the Mount Hua Sect and one of the Three Great Swordsmen, defeats the Heavenly Demon Chun Ma but dies from his wounds. A hundred years later, he is reborn in the body of a young child. Shocked to discover that the once-great Mount Hua Sect has fallen into ruin, Chung Myung begins his second life determined to restore the sect to its former glory.
author: Biga
